svg.title: Pegasus shared memory IPC architecture
svg.desc: Lock-free shared memory queue between Market Data Gateway, Matching Engine, and Custody Verifier, showing the mmap segment layout with ProtocolHeader, dual counters, and ring buffer.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does the Market Data Gateway write to mmap?')
sendPrompt('How does the Matching Engine read from mmap?')
sendPrompt('How does the Custody Verifier process trade records?')
sendPrompt('What is in the mmap Quote segment header?')
sendPrompt('Who writes to write_counter and why is it on its own cache line?')
sendPrompt('Who reads read_counter and why separate cache line?')
sendPrompt('How are Quote structs laid out in the ring buffer?')
sendPrompt('What is in the mmap Trade segment?')
sendPrompt('Why does each mmap segment have its own ProtocolHeader?')
sendPrompt('How are Trade structs copied into the ring buffer?')

svg.text: sequence gap → stale-data suppression · no kernel involvement on hot path
